text:
maya: Morning async — quick standup for pipeline + sec asks.

maya: What I did: demo'd Dedicated pilot flow for AcmeHealth yesterday (went well), sent infra checklist to their infra lead.
maya: Blockers: Acme asked for HSM keywrap details and whether we support key import with customer KMS. Need a clear answer for Friday.
maya: Today: follow up on HSM docs, loop in eng/security for KMS integration note, and ping contracts for NDA addendum.

alex: thanks — re HSM: we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM in Private; key import path exists but depends on HSM vendor. I'll pull the exact vendor matrix.

chris: Alex + Maya — I can attach the HSM keywrap PoC notes (we used AWS CloudHSM + AWS KMS in the last pilot). Quick snippet for the sequence we recommend:
```
1. Customer creates key in their KMS.
2. Generate exportable wrapping key in HSM.
3. Use wrapping key to encrypt model-serving keys.
4. Upload wrapped keys to Redwood Private package via secure channel.
```
chris: I'll put full doc in the sales-drive folder and link below.

maya: perfect, @chris please also include any audit log steps (who/when keys rotated). Acme is regulated (PHI).

sam: flag — Acme asked for an SLA on latency for small-batched requests. Is that something Dedicated can promise out of box?

chris: Dedicated can target 95th latency SLA for their committed pool. We should avoid promising without engineering signoff. cc: @alex for commit numbers.

alex: Confirm — we can offer SLA if they commit to a 3-month reserved capacity (N GPUs). I'll coordinate numbers with pricing.

lina: Legal note: if they require HSM KYC or on-prem access, we need the NDA addendum + a supplier security questionnaire. I can draft a one-pager.

maya: great — timeline: need HSM detail + one-pager by EOD Fri.

chris: Quick ask for eng: can someone from eng-runtime review the PoC steps? small CR to the onboarding doc: add the HSM wrap step and a KMS vendor table. Who can take a 30m async review?

alex: I can do the review tomorrow morning.

security-bot: [auto] Security checklist status: AcmeHealth -> controls outstanding: encryption-at-rest confirm, key-rotation policy, SOC2 evidence. Please attach artefacts.

maya: thanks bot. I'll attach the SOC2 link and rotation policy after lina's doc.

sam: Deal blocker roundup: 1) HSM details 2) SLA numbers 3) NDA addendum 4) Procurement PO timing. If we hit all, likely sign in 2–3 weeks.

maya: action items:
- chris: upload HSM PoC doc + audit walkthrough (today)
- alex: pricing + SLA numbers (tomorrow AM)
- lina: NDA addendum draft (tomorrow)
- maya: consolidate and send Acme recap (Fri EOD)

maya: pinging @chris @alex @lina — please react when complete :thumbsup:

alex: noted.

chris: on it.

lina: will share draft tomorrow.

maya: thanks team — short updates here as you finish so I can keep Acme looped in.

sam: FYI — raising a quick internal ask: if Acme requests VPC peering, networking will need 24–48h to set up for the pilot once paperwork is done.

maya: noted, I'll include that tempo in the recap.

chris: linking docs: https://drive.redwood/acme/hsm-poc (working draft), onboarding checklist: https://drive.redwood/acme/onboarding-checklist

maya: closing note — if anyone needs me to jump on a short call with their counterpart at Acme, I have a slot 3–3:30p PT today.

alex: can do 3:00.

maya: cool. I'll set calendar and include the draft one-pager.

maya: end of thread.
